_comment: Upstream lives only on framagit, which drops this network's egress and has no
maintained third-party mirror. These point at HomeLabHD's own mirrors so a build
never depends on Framasoft being both up and willing to talk to us.
Refreshing the mirrors tracks upstream; bumping a ref here is what ships it.
